text: いい　できばえ　じゃないか！

structure.jp: いい　できばえ　じゃないか！
structure.en: That's a fine result, isn't it!

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.span: できばえ　じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか at the end does not say 'not' here; it strongly says 'it really is, isn't it!', often with surprise or praise. いい　できばえ　じゃないか = 'that's a fine result, isn't it!'.
